Tezi is a Zandalari troll worshiper of Bwonsamdi. He was captured by the Widow's Bite and ordered by Nathanos Blightcaller to summon loa at his Necropolis. He initially refused, knowing that his captors and their allies sought to kill his loa, but reluctantly relented when they attempted to break a young child worshiper. When Bwonsamdi appeared, Tezi and the rest of the worshipers fell flat on the ground in reverence, as Nathanos gave the order to attack. His fate is unknown.

Terrapins are a type of turtles native to Bastion. They are some of the most ancient creatures in all of the Shadowlands and never stop growing as they age, infusing ancient ambient anima into their protective shells as they do. The oldest terrapins grow crystalline structures throughout their bodies. Though they may look friendly, a bite from their beaks can sever the digits of even a centurion. Terrapins prefer berries as their primary food source, though they will eat almost anything. Contrary to popular belief, a terrapin's diet has nothing to do with its shell color. The brightscales are the rarest type of terrapin seen in the wild. Rubbing the top of one's shell is considered lucky.
Terrapin Hatchlings are small juvenile terrapins located in the Garden of Respite in Bastion.

The Thandol Span is a set of massive stone bridges connecting the Wetlands of northern Khaz Modan with the Arathi Highlands of southeastern Lordaeron. It is one of the greatest engineering projects ever completed by the dwarves, having been under the guard of the Anvilmars for at least three generations. The area where it is located was once known as the Thandol Valley.

The Age of Galakrond is a book by Senior Historian Evelyna. The book's third chapter describes Galakrond's battle with Tyr and his five proto-dragon companions, and how Galakrond managed to devour Tyr's hand. Chapter nine details how Jotun forged a new silver hand for Tyr, and how he also reforged Tyr's warhammer to incorporate the image of this new appendage. During the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion, this book was available as an item. However, it was removed prior to release.

The Art of Warcraft artbook was originally distributed in the Warcraft III Collector's Edition, which was sold for a limited time in 2002. The artbook was later offered for purchase as a single item with its own ISBN, but like the Collectors Edition of the game, has since gone out of print. However, both the Collector's Edition of Warcraft III and The Art of Warcraft book can still be found for sale at various book outlets and on auction sites like eBay, in used condition.

The Art of World of Warcraft, also The Art of World of Warcraft Coffee Table Book, artbook was originally distributed in the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition. It was later reprinted in its original hardcover form while the one provided with the Collector's Edition did not have an ISBN. Unlike The Art of Warcraft artbook, this artbook contains no commentary.

The Beast is a core hound boss found at the Furnace in Upper Blackrock Spire. This minion of Ragnaros was captured by Nefarian's forces, tortured for their amusement, and then retrained to guard the spire from intruders. One such intruder, Pip Quickwit, was swallowed whole by the Beast in the pits at the Molten Span. With the protection of his lava-proof suit, the gnome remained in the belly of the Beast for some time (varying from "months" to "the better part of a month"), and he can be freed by skinning the Beast. Pip was rescued by some adventurers.
The Angry Scytheclaws is the 6th quest in the Isha Awak quest chain. It begins and ends with Sergra Darkthorn.

Completing The Art of the Armorsmith grants a blacksmith the specialization of Armorsmith. It is highly useful to complete the quest chain, to acquire the plans needed to forge the items this quest requires. This quest becomes available once you talk to Myolor Sunderfury and declare you want to become an armorsmith.
This quest is part of the quest chain, which allows blacksmiths to specialize in Armorsmithing.
The Battleboars is the 2nd quest in the The Hunt Continues quest chain.
The Azure Key is the Rogue class-specific Sunken Temple Quest. It is a long quest chain that yields a very good item for its level.
This quest is part of the Rewriting the Battle of Darrowshire quest chain (Classic).

The Balance of Light and Shadow is the quest that priests must complete in order to get the epic staff Benediction/Anathema. Upon completion, your quest reward will be the Splinter of Nordrassil. You then combine the Splinter with The Eye of Divinity and The Eye of Shadow to create the staff.
This is one of the Blasted Lands buff quests. It rewards characters with an elixir giving +25 intellect for a period of 60 minutes.
The Ata'mal Terrace is a group quest where you have to defeat Shadowlord Deathwail to get the Heart of Fury. It is suggested that you bring a group of 5 to fight him.
The Ashtongue Corruptors sends the player off to defeat four Corruptors, Broken shaman who now corrupt the elements they were entrusted to protect.
The Assassin is a quest which sends the adventurer to ambush an assassin. It begins a quest chain through which Horde players become neutral with the Mag'har.
This quest is part of the quest chain. :Warning! Participating in this quest will switch on your PvP flag for 5 minutes.

This is a list of all quests from the Barrens in table format (arranged by level). For a questing guide detailing the best order to obtain and complete quests in the Barrens, see The Barrens questing guide. ; Alliance: There are few Alliance-only quests which take place in the Barrens. Many Alliance warlock quests take place in Ratchet - those are listed below in the class quest section. In addition, Alliance players can partake of several neutral quests from Ratchet. ; Horde: The Barrens is a huge questing hub for the Horde from level 10-20. It is the main 10-20 area for 3 of the Horde's 5 races, and even undead and blood elves often choose to come here to quest. ;Class quests: The Barrens
The Battle at Crestfall is the twelfth mission of the Alliance campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.
The Battle at Darrowmere is the ninth mission of the Alliance campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.

The Art of World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade artbook was originally distributed in The Burning Crusade Collector's Edition. It features the early development of The Burning Crusade, as well as the later patches of classic World of Warcraft.
The Awakening of Stormrage is Chapter 3 of the night elf campaign, Eternity's End.
The Armor of Mannoroth was located in Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar before Cataclysm. Mannoroth's skull was also hung on the dead tree that had been bleached white by the sun.
The Assassination of Harold Lane is the climax of the D.E.H.T.A. questline. You will only have access to it after completing all of the quests listed in the progression below.

The Avalanche is an area in northeastern Sholazar Basin. When the Lifeblood Pillar was sabotaged by the Cult of the Damned and fell, that allowed snows from Icecrown to collapse into the basin, creating the Avalanche and giving the Scourge a pathway in the region, with flesh giants and abominations patrolling the snows. The Lost Lands spread out from the Avalanche, an area blighted and dying, the air fouled with a yellow haze, and the ground thick with undead. High above, lies the Fleshwerks in Icecrown, a large facility of the Scourge which is dedicated to the creation of abominations and flesh giants. The Badlands is the sixth mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness.
The Annals of the Great Alliance was a book written by the high elf Milan. The entire history of the Second War is recorded in it.
The Argent Champion is a reputation achievement that requires players to reach exalted with both argent factions.
The Ascension is the cinematic finale of Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne.
"The Archmage Antonidas" is a three-part story told by the different books in Dalaran.
The Art of World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King artbook was originally distributed in the Wrath of the Lich King Collector's Edition.
The Arachnid Quarter (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the bossess of the Arachnid Quarter of Naxxramas on 10-player mode.
The Antechamber of Ulduar (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the bosses of The Antechamber area of Ulduar on 10-player mode.
The Arcatraz is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Arcatraz instance on normal or heroic difficulty.
The Battle for Mount Hyjal is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Hyjal Summit raid instance.
The Astral Walker is a title awarded when you complete Heroic: Observed by defeating Algalon the Observer on heroic difficulty. The title appears after your character's name: :"" the Astral Walker
The Assembly of Iron is a large room found within Ulduar, just outside of the Archivum. The three main creations of iron can be found here.
The Argent Crusade is an achievement gained by getting with the Argent Crusade in Northrend.
The Arena Master is a Legacy achievement earned for completing the arena achievements. It awards the title .
The Ashen Verdict is an achievement gained by getting with the Ashen Verdict in Icecrown Citadel.

the Argent Defender was a title obtained by earning the achievement A Tribute to Dedicated Insanity, which was considered the ultimate achievement for the Trial of the Crusader in 10-player Heroic mode. The achievement involved not wiping on any bosses in the instance and limiting players in the raid group to a maximum item level. The title precedes the character's name in the following format: : the Argent Defender
The Argent Dawn is an achievement for reaching status with the Argent Dawn.
The Assassin's Creed seems to be a guide for rogues. It's only mentioned in the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game.
The Battle for Hillsbrad drops from Clerk Horrace Whitesteed in the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.
The Awakening is the opening cinematic for the Terror of the Tides campaign. In this cinematic we see Illidan Stormrage summoning naga from the dark tides.
The objective of the quests that these three different people offer only differ in where they start, namely Western Plaguelands, Cape of Stranglethorn, and Hinterlands.
The object that starts this quest is gained from one of the mobs killed for Guardians of Stratholme
The Arts of a Rogue is a quest that introduces Eviscerate to gnome rogues.

The Bastion of Twilight is a Cataclysm raid achievement rewarded for completing the Bastion of Twilight.
The Bastion of Twilight Guild Run is an achievement that is awarded for defeating all bosses in the Bastion of Twilight raid instance while in a guild group.

The Art of Cataclysm is a book containing 176 pages of art including never-before-seen images from the archives of the Blizzard Film Department and the World of Warcraft development team. It was included in the Cataclysm Collector's Edition.

This quest is part of the Children's Week quests where you escort the orcish orphan Grunth. All of Ridin' the Rocketway, The Fallen Chieftain, and The Banshee Queen must be completed to progress to the next pair of quests.

The Battle for Darkshore completes the Grove of the Ancients quest chain, in which the druids of the Grove of the Ancients enlist Alliance adventurers' aid to bring to an end the Twilight's Hammer activity at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore.
The Battle for Mount Hyjal Guild Run is a guild achievement that is awarded for defeating the final boss of the Battle for Mount Hyjal raid while in a guild group.
The Arboretum is a shop located in the upper level of The Drag in Orgrimmar, especially important to those seeking training in Herbalism. It is the closest shop to the Valley of Wisdom on that level.

The Art of World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria is a book containing 208 pages of art including never-before-seen pieces from early concepts to final 3D renderings. It was included in the Mists of Pandaria Collector's Edition.
The August Celestials is an achievement that is awarded for earn exalted status with August Celestials.

The Assault on Shaol'mara begins the second stage of the Isle of Thunder storyline. Jaina will only offer this quest on deck of The Seabolt once enough realm-wide progress has been made, irrespective of the individual player's standing with the Kirin Tor Offensive. The quest mostly plays out in a single-player scenario also called "The Assault on Shaol'mara". As the scenario can only be done once, it is documented here and not in a separate article.
The Bear and the Lady Fair is found on the corpses of Sargerei draenei on Socrethar's Rise in and in and around in Talador. Before patch 6.0, this item was found in Greater Cache of Treasures.

The Barnacle is a sunken frigate found off the southern cost of Timeless Isle. Occasionally, the Battle of the Barnacle takes place, where a ghostly crew under the command of Captain Zvezdan fends off three waves of five skeletons led by Rattleskew. Winning the encounter may award Captain Zvezdan's Lost Leg and a timeless armor piece.
The Barbed Horror is a rare scorpid that can be found on the plateau to the southwest of the Shimmering Deep in Thousand Needles.
The Battle for Nethergarde is the second mission of the Alliance campaign in Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal.
